description: This Java source file defines the HibernateTemplateDAO class which implements data access object methods for managing Template entities in the OpenMRS system. It provides CRUD operations, utilizing Hibernate sessions, and logs actions.

classes.name: HibernateTemplateDAO
classes.description: Implementation of TemplateDAO using Hibernate to perform database operations for Template entities.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Setter for sessionFactory dependency, used for injecting Hibernate SessionFactory.

methods.name: getTemplates
methods.description: Retrieves all Template entities from the database.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Fetches a Template by its ID.

methods.name: getTemplatesByName
methods.description: Fetches templates matching a given name.

methods.name: createTemplate
methods.description: Creates or updates a template in the database.

methods.name: updateTemplate
methods.description: Updates an existing template, or creates it if the ID is null.

methods.name: deleteTemplate
methods.description: Deletes a template from the database.
